lines.text: We read six ashwagandha labels. These three are worth buying.
lines.say: We read six ashwagandha labels. These three are worth buying.

lines.text: Buy the extract, not the brand. Look for a named root extract, at 300 to 600 milligrams a day.
lines.say: Buy the extract, not the brand. Look for a named root extract, at three hundred to six hundred milligrams a day.

lines.text: Best overall: NOW KSM-66, 600 milligrams. One capsule a day, the dose that did best in the trials. About 37 cents a day.
lines.say: Best overall: Now K S M sixty-six, six hundred milligrams. One capsule a day, the dose that did best in the trials. About thirty-seven cents a day.

lines.text: For a split dose: Jarrow Formulas, 300 milligrams. One capsule twice a day. About 42 cents a day.
lines.say: For a split dose: Jarrow Formulas, three hundred milligrams. One capsule twice a day. About forty-two cents a day.

lines.text: Best on a budget: NOW Ashwagandha 450. 19 cents a day. But it is not one of the extracts the trials tested.
lines.say: Best on a budget: Now Ashwagandha four fifty. Nineteen cents a day. But it is not one of the extracts the trials tested.

lines.text: The Goli gummies? About $1.67 a day, with 8 grams of sugar.
lines.say: The Goli gummies? About a dollar sixty-seven a day, with eight grams of sugar.

lines.text: And remember: a bigger number is not a stronger product.
lines.say: And remember: a bigger number is not a stronger product.

lines.text: Do not take ashwagandha if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
lines.say: Do not take ashwagandha if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

lines.text: The full comparison is on our YouTube channel. Follow SharpAndLean for more.
